items.definition:
the ability to present something in an attractive or impressive way
His performance was full of excellent showmanship.

a collection of statues
The museum displayed an impressive collection of ancient statuary.

an organism living in symbiosis
The clownfish and sea anemone form a classic example of a symbiote relationship.

a donut-shaped surface
In geometry, a torus is a surface of revolution generated by revolving a circle in three-dimensional space about an axis coplanar with the circle.

a device that can transmit and receive
The radio operator used a powerful transceiver to communicate with the ship.

the act of changing into another form
Alchemists sought the transmutation of base metals into gold.

A word, idiom, or other feature characteristic of American English.
The word 'fall' for autumn is an example of an Americanism.

An intense military campaign intended to bring about a swift victory.
The German army employed blitzkrieg tactics during the early stages of the war.

Agreement or consistency.
There was general concurrence among the committee members on the proposal.

An abundance or plentiful supply of something.
The market offered a cornucopia of fresh fruits and vegetables.

The fact of no longer being on friendly terms
There was a long period of estrangement between the siblings.

Ornamental work of fine wire formed into delicate tracery
The antique locket was decorated with delicate filigree.

The advancement of a scheme or interest
The funds were used in furtherance of the charity's goals.

A sheer, lightweight, dull-finished crêpe fabric
The dress was made of a beautiful silk georgette.

a title of respect used before the name of a revered person, especially in Islam
Hazrat Muhammad is revered by Muslims worldwide.

monetary inflation occurring at a very high rate
The country experienced severe hyperinflation, making its currency almost worthless.

an adherent of an ideology, especially one who is uncompromising and dogmatic
He was seen as a rigid ideologue, unwilling to compromise his beliefs.

a peculiarity of constitution or temperament; an individualizing characteristic or quality
One of his many idiosyncrasies was his habit of always wearing two different colored socks.

cruel and brutal behavior
The war crimes trial exposed the full extent of the inhumanity committed.

the process of designing a software application so that it can be adapted to various languages and regions without engineering changes
The company's internationalization strategy involved adapting its products for different markets.

a type of edible seaweed
In Wales, laver is often used to make laverbread.

the political theory for the organization of a revolutionary vanguard party and the achievement of a dictatorship of the proletariat, as conceived by the Russian revolutionary Vladimir Lenin
Leninism is a political ideology derived from Marxism.

A print produced by lithography.
The artist created a beautiful lithograph of the city skyline.

A type of soil or rock consisting of clay and lime.
The farmers used marl to enrich the soil.

A type of cell division that reduces the number of chromosomes.
Meiosis is essential for sexual reproduction.

A person of integrity and honor.
He's a true mensch, always helping others.

nearsightedness
Her severe myopia requires her to wear thick glasses.

a fragrant gum resin
Myrrh was one of the gifts brought by the Magi.

a salt or ester of nitrous acid
Sodium nitrite is used as a food preservative.

refusal to accept any standard short of perfection
Her perfectionism often led to delays in completing projects.

the quality or state of being periodic
The periodicity of the tides is influenced by the moon's gravity.

a synthetic fluorescent or phosphorescent substance
The screen of the old television used a phosphor coating to display images.

a word blending the sounds and meanings of two others; a large suitcase
The word 'smog' is a portmanteau of 'smoke' and 'fog'.

a collection of beliefs or practices mistakenly regarded as being based on scientific method
Astrology is often considered a pseudoscience rather than a true science.

a person who bases their opinions and actions on reason and knowledge
As a rationalist, she always sought logical explanations for phenomena.

the rejection of a proposal or idea; denial of truth or validity
The government's repudiation of the treaty caused an international uproar.

a raised platform on which a speaker stands to address an audience
The speaker approached the rostrum to deliver his powerful speech.

a type of juniper tree
The savin is a species of juniper native to central and southern Europe.

a smooth transition
The speaker made a smooth segue from one topic to the next.

a type of varnish
He applied a coat of shellac to the wooden table.

the quality of being sound or reliable
The engineer checked the structural soundness of the bridge.

a type of antelope native to southern Africa
The springbok is known for its distinctive pronking behavior.

a chapter of the Quran
Each sura of the Quran contains verses of varying lengths.

a private romantic rendezvous
They arranged a secret tryst by the old oak tree.

the process of arranging type for printing
Modern typesetting is mostly done digitally.

a pulsating effect produced in singing or playing an instrument
The singer added a beautiful vibrato to the final note.

a North American freshwater fish
He caught a large walleye during his fishing trip.

a device that measures acceleration
Smartphones use an accelerometer to detect orientation.

a winter sport similar to ice hockey
The bandy team practiced on the frozen lake.

a large group of people or things of a particular kind
A bevy of reporters gathered outside the courthouse.

the application of engineering principles to biological systems
She is studying bioengineering at university.

dense, thorny scrubland found in California and the Mediterranean
Wildfires are common in chaparral ecosystems.

the state of having been abandoned and become dilapidated; neglect of duty
The old building was in a state of complete dereliction.

disagreement that leads to discord
There was much dissension among the committee members regarding the new policy.

private or identifying information about an individual, published on the internet without their consent
He threatened to publish her dox if she didn't comply.

an internal organ, especially an intestine
The hunter carefully removed the entrails from the deer.

sexual desire or excitement; the use of sexual images or language
The film explored themes of love and eroticism.

a feeling of great happiness and excitement
She felt a sense of exhilaration after completing the marathon.

the action of estimating or concluding something by assuming that existing trends will continue or a current method will remain applicable
The report's conclusions were based on an extrapolation of current data.

a style or form that is not restricted by rules or conventions
The artist preferred a freeform approach to sculpture.

a person who fits glass into windows or doors
The glazier carefully installed the new pane of glass.

The tendency to use one hand more skillfully than the other
Research shows that handedness is often determined before birth.

A fierce, bad-tempered woman; also a type of fighter plane
She was known as a hellcat in her youth.

A very unpleasant place
The prison was described as a hellhole by former inmates.
